integrity: The analytic proof uses exact polynomial identities, the renewal recursion, and a one-parameter boundary obstruction; the independent audit is unperformed.
scientific_limitations: The disproof concerns support size four; no classification of all maximal minorants or inference for support size five and above is asserted. The coefficient is optimal only along the stated monomial perturbation direction.
title: A sharp cubic renewal minorant disproves four-step maximality
